scope: Cross-feature functional review and targeted UI v2 implementation. This is not a claim that every production mutation or every browser has been exhaustively tested.

validation.productionStaticBuild: passed with /our-days base path; temporary QA route excluded
validation.productionCss: UI v2 selectors present after a fresh cache build

coverage.area: Home / daily log / mood / question / shortcuts
coverage.method: authenticated home observation, source review and regression suite
coverage.change: shared navigation semantics; targeted log-comment rollback and visible failure feedback

coverage.method: records and diary and photo entry-point inspection, source and existing tests
coverage.change: shared header and keyboard-accessible segmented control; photo progressive grid and distinct read-error state

coverage.method: authenticated calendar and bucket observations; real BucketList component with injected in-memory repository for mutations
coverage.change: search, status filters, 44px completion target, composition-safe form, synchronous mutation guard, per-item rollback and confirmed write results

coverage.method: authenticated together entry-point observation, settings/connection source and existing regression tests
coverage.change: shared header; common main-sheet focus containment and restoration

coverage.area: Game hub / pet / garden / workshop / decoration / hunt
coverage.method: authenticated game-hub observation; source and engine regression tests; shared island-sheet component exercised in local fixture
coverage.change: hub load error/retry, request-order protection, duplicate initial load removal; shared island sheet close affordance and nested focus handling

coverage.method: source and component inspection; in-memory nested sheet/confirm browser tests
coverage.change: retryable activity errors without clearing cached events; shared loading/error/empty panels; confirmation above island sheets

browserChecks.environment: Codex in-app browser, local component fixture and production entry-point observation
passed: one keyboard tab stop per radio group
successful insert retained after read failure
initial read failure does not show empty-list suggestions
Escape closes only the top dialog
confirmation restores the invoking sheet button
final CSS rebuilt without stale development cache

limitations: No destructive production CRUD, partner notifications, real purchases, coupling/unpairing or account changes were exercised.
Native iOS Safari and Android browser keyboard/safe-area behavior still requires real-device QA.
Two signed-in users editing simultaneously was not end-to-end tested.
Photo progressive rendering bounds the DOM, but fetching/signing the complete album remains unchanged; server pagination is a separate follow-up.
The common main sheet, island sheets and confirmation now use the focus hook; remaining bespoke viewers/editors were not all migrated.
This request is implemented locally; publishing this new UI v2 release is separate from the already deployed hero-art/motion release.
